Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for opposite parties no.1 to 4 and Sri Virendra Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for opposite party no.5.

Cause shown in the affidavit filed in support of the application for restoration as well as the application for condonation of delay (C.M. Application No.102702 of 2019 ) for recalling the order dated 1.5.2017, is sufficient.
Delay is condoned and the application for restoration is allowed.
The order dated 1.5.2017 is recalled and the writ petition is restored to its original number. .

Case :- MISC. BENCH No. - 8227 of 2008 Petitioner :- Mohd. Ahmad S/O Mohd. Ayub Respondent :- State Of U.P. Through Secretary Home Counsel for Petitioner :- Farooq Ayub

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Virendra Kumar Shukla Hon'ble Anil Kumar,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Standing Counsel for opposite parties no.1 to 4 and Sri Virendra Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for opposite party no.5.

Since the point involved in the present writ petition is trivial in nature, so with the consent of learned counsel for the parties ,
who are present today, the present writ petition is being decided.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are doing the business of slaughtering of selling of buffalo's meat from the time of his ancestral in village Ratauli, Police-Station Safadarganj in District Barabanki, but all of sudden on 3.1.2008, the opposite party no.4 started hindrance and interference in peaceful working and business of the petitioner's with the help of some unsocial and powerful person of the area in an illegal and arbitrary manner without any jurisdiction and they tried to stop the aforesaid business of the petitioner and on which the petitioner immediately submitted a representation dated 8.1.2008 before the opposite party no.2/District Magistrate and opposite party no.3/ Superintendent of Police, Barabanki to take action in the matter.

However, no action has been taken by opposite parties no. 2 and 3 , so the present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with the following prayers:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite parties i.e. opposite party no.4 not to make any interference or hindrance in peaceful functioning and carrying on the business of the petitioners of slaughtering and selling buffalo's meat in village Ratauli Post Maufali, Police-Station Safadarganj ,
District Barabanki.

(ii) A writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus be issued commanding the opposite parties no.2 and 3 to take suitable action against opposite party no.4 with respect for complaint made by the petitioners through representation dated 8.1.2008 Mohd. 2 and 17.1.2008 contained as Anneuxre nos. 1 and 2 to the this writ petition."

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to file a fresh application under the provisions of the new Act, viz Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 as amended before the designated authority within a period of four weeks from today.

If such application is preferred by the petitioners to the designated authority, the same shall be considered and decided by him, strictly in accordance with law,
expeditiously, say within a period of six weeks from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order along with application. .
